newsitem.title: ALBANIA: Albania rioters burn oil HQ as violence mounts.
newsitem.headline: Albania rioters burn oil HQ as violence mounts.

text.p: Albanian rioters set on fire the headquarters of state-owned oil company Albpetrol in the southern town of Patos on Sunday, an Albpetrol official said.
"The main offices of Albpetrol were burned," the official told Reuters by telephone. He was speaking from the neighbouring town of Fieri, 115 km (80 miles) south of Tirana.
The Albpetrol official did not say how many people were involved in the incident, nor whether there were any injuries.

The attack on Albpetrol's offices, which happened on Sunday morning, was the latest escalation in two weeks of disturbances triggered by depositors' anger at the collapse of a nationwide network of pyramid investment schemes.
The schemes, offering savers big returns for small outlays, proliferated across Europe's poorest nation since the fall of communism in 1990.
In the southern town of Vlore rioters set fire to the town hall, imitating similar attacks in nearby towns on Saturday and Friday.
In Tirana some 30,000 people defied police to gather in the central Skanderbeg Square, scene of numerous anti-government clashes, to demand the resignation of the ruling right-wing Democratic Party.
